## Glyphling 0.7.0

Download `Glyphling-Setup-0.7.0.exe` below and run it. It updates an existing installation in place.

### New positioning
- **The circle is the only reference point.** It always stays fully on screen, 24 px from the edges and above the taskbar. "Two positions" is gone.
- **Smarter panel side.** Auto opens toward the middle of the screen, or to the other side when only that one has room. With Left or Right forced and no room, the circle slides away from the edge while the panel is open and slides back when it closes.
- **Quick positions** in Settings > Position: corners, edge middles and center. With the panel open, the middle ones center circle + panel together. Dragging by hand switches back to a free position; "Centra" is the center quick position.

### Also
- New opening and closing animation of the panel.
- Two easter eggs for the mascot: shake the mouse left and right over it, or circle around it fast.

The setup is not signed yet: Windows SmartScreen may warn on first launch ("More info" → "Run anyway").
